page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, with Hebrew, Syriac, Chaldee and Greek words. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number 408 at top right. A catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: constr. מַעֲלֵי הַוּ Feliciores fuerunt, Thren.4.9.
עלו Syr. Aloe, Αλωή, Johan.19.38. Chald. dicitur אֲלוֹאִין.

עלל Ch.&Syr.Introire, ingredi,intrare.De Sole, est Occidere, occumbere. Usurpatur promiscuè in formis Quiescendium secunda, & Defectivorum secunda. Aphel אַעֵל Introire facere, ducere,adducere,introducere, inducere, pducere, proferre, afferre. Ithpehal אִתְעַל Introduci, immitti, inferri. Ethpah.Syr. ܐܬܥܠ Ingressus est, Joh.13.27. Pahel עלל Racemare; & geminatè עלעל Turbine, procellis agitare, Jobi 27.21.
עַלַלְתָּא, עַלְלָא, עַלַּל Ch. ܥܠܠܬܐ Syr. Proventus, reditus, fructus. Plur. Syr. ܥܠܠܐ, Lucæ 12.15.16.
מַעֲלָנָא Chal. & Syr. Introitus, porta: Occasus cùm de Sole sermo est: vel de Luna, ut Ezech.1.1. בְּתַר מַעֲלָנִי סִיהֲרָא Post occasum Lunæ. Plur. מַעֲלָנִי, מַעֲלָנִין.
מַעֲלִי Ch.Idem; Hinc & pro Vespera, בְּמַעֲלִי יוֹמָא דְּפִסְחָא In vespera diei paschatis, scil. prima, in initio diei paschatis, Ruth.1.v.22.
ܥܠܝܢ Syr. Introitus, ingressus, ad Hebr.4.1.
עֲלָא, עֲלָה Ch. ܥܠܐ, ܥܠܐ Syr.Causla,Occasio:Prætextus, excusatio, ܥܠܐ Eâ occasione, sub prætextu. Vide quoque supra in עלה.

page.notes: Many Hebrew, Syriac and Greek words are set in mixed type; the transcription of the vowel points and Syriac forms is approximate and marked where doubtful. The entry for Ethpah and the Syriac in the Hebrew lines are uncertain. The catchword at the lower right is taken as שלעול.
